# Fiscal position (`fiscal-position` v1)

Government revenue, spending, deficit and debt, and spending by function.

**Group:** Economics · **Mnemonic:** `FISC` · **Identifiers:** `FISC-…` in `fiscalId`

Open one with `FISC <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: fiscal-position
version: 1
description: "Government revenue, spending, deficit and debt, and spending by function."
match: { kind: fiscal-position, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Economics · Fiscal position, id: $.fiscalId }
strip:
  - { label: Economy, bind: $.economyName }
  - { label: Revenue / GDP, bind: $.revenue, fmt: pct2 }
  - { label: Spending / GDP, bind: $.spending, fmt: pct2 }
  - { label: Balance / GDP, bind: $.balance, fmt: pct2, tone: sign, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Debt / GDP, bind: $.debt, fmt: pct0 }
  - { label: Interest / revenue, bind: $.interestBurden, fmt: pct2 }
panels:
  - id: functions
    kind: hbar
    title: Spending by function (% of GDP)
    key: F2
    rows: $.functions
    label: function
    value: share
    fmt: pct2
  - id: debtPath
    kind: line
    title: Debt / GDP
    area: right
    rows: $.debtPath
    x: year
    y: debt
    fmt: pct0
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.economy, 'economy')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
